title: Rate of global sea level rise (mm/year)

source.name: Satellite Record of Sea Level Rise From 1993 to 2024

notes: NASA/JPL satellite altimetry record (TOPEX/Poseidon through Sentinel-6). The rate of global mean sea level rise was about 2.1 mm/year in 1993 and has roughly doubled to about 4.5 mm/year by 2024.
